card.name: Invisible marks after cross-references and emails
card.fires_on: Responds (negatively) to an invisible left-to-right mark character after a bracketed 'see Warnings and Precautions' reference, and to '.com' in placeholder email addresses. Also seen on a closing '$' after a math variable.

modes.label: Invisible mark after cross-reference
modes.description: A hidden directional mark right after a bracketed 'see Warnings and Precautions (x.x)' citation in label text.
modes.example: prescribing and reassess all patients regularly for the development of these behaviors and conditions ‎[see Warnings and Precautions (5.1) ]<<‎>> . Life-Threatening Respiratory Depression

modes.label: .com in example emails
modes.description: The '.com' ending of a placeholder email address such as email@example, often in contact lists.

modes.description: The closing '$' after a math symbol such as p_0 in inline formulas.
